description:
Unit: U7
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u7-reconcile-quality-evidence-current-documentation-and-final-parity

Outcome
Quality evidence, current documentation, CI, and the full repository agree on one final test tree.

Requirements and decisions
R1-R15; KTD1-KTD8.

Affected surfaces
mix.exs; config/config.exs; .github/workflows/ci.yml; .dialyzer_ignore.exs; current README files; test/contracts/README.md; test/contracts/coverage.json; test/contracts/coverage.static.json; test/quality/**; and all final catalogs and manifests.

Implementation direction
Sweep active code, config, current README files, CI, catalogs, manifest targets, and quality maps for retired paths and module names. Preserve historical plan text and source-manifest source_path values. Confirm coverage.static.json has no active consumer, remove it, and regenerate required Covenant coverage. Reconcile all deletion ledgers. Run complete required-offline and quality proof on a clean integrated revision. Compare final test-tree duplication with the U1 baseline. Add no permanent path-layout gate.

Acceptance
Manifest targets exist and are unique. Quality evidence paths resolve to final source or ignored output paths. Covenant IDs and active counts match the baseline with 100 percent coverage. Required offline aliases pass. Live and service remain opt-in. A scoped residue review finds no retired active path, old test-only module, compatibility module, or layout guard. Final clone counts are lower than baseline.

Verification
mix compile --warnings-as-errors
mix format --check-formatted
mix test.ci
mix quality.contract
mix quality.coverage
mix quality.report
mix reach.check --arch --smells
mix ex_dna test --max-clones 999
git diff --check

Completion signal
The plan Definition of Done is true on the clean integrated revision.
title: U7 Reconcile quality evidence and final parity
